info.title: Real food. Real macros.
info.second: Made in small batches, frozen at peak, and already logged in MyFitnessPal so the only thing you have to track is your lift.

steps.label: Pan (recommended)
steps.text: Remove parchment paper and heat on a pan until warm and soft.

steps.label: Quick option
steps.text: Microwave each piece between a paper towel for 10–15 seconds.

steps.label: Track it
steps.text: Log your meal in MyFitnessPal — just search “PRATUS”.
